scope: Daily full-universe verification across Power / Grid, AI / Data centres, Nuclear, Uranium / Fuel, Oil & Gas, Metals, Robotics / Automation, current holdings and adjacent themes in US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia.
decision: No wholesale base-conviction reset. The Aug 26 sweep changes relative ranking through the live macro overlay: move further toward generation/grid/electrical/connectivity/reliability and away from financing-sensitive or pre-commercial AI duration. Current holdings fundamental scores remain unchanged; daily theme/funding overlays are shown separately.

developingStoryOverlay.aiFinancing: Treat the reported growth in hyperscaler off-balance-sheet commitments, SPVs, leases and private-credit structures as a financing-quality stress lens rather than a substitute for filings. Distinguish physical demand from the quality and cost of funding that demand.
developingStoryOverlay.powerBottleneck: Time-to-power is now the preferred cross-stock discriminator. Generation, grid equipment, switchgear, transformers, substations, cable, backup power and networking gain relative priority.
developingStoryOverlay.elNino: Use El Nino as a second-order supply-chain scenario: export restrictions, fertilizer demand, hydro-to-thermal switching, canal/freight disruption and tanker tonne-miles matter more than weather headlines alone.
developingStoryOverlay.china: Do not assume weak Chinese data automatically produces a bazooka. Prefer strategic power/equipment/industrial-upgrading exposures over indiscriminate domestic-demand beta until policy changes materially.
developingStoryOverlay.debasement: Weak-dollar/lower-yield support for gold and Bitcoin can coexist with poor entry quality when positioning is crowded; macro thesis and trade quality remain separate.
developingStoryOverlay.bearCaseDiscipline: Every bullish theme now carries an explicit failure mechanism around AI ROI, private credit, government debt, rates, valuation and cash conversion.

macro.ism: July 2026 remains the latest official ISM dataset: Manufacturing PMI 55.6 and Services PMI 54.1. August Manufacturing and Services are due Sep 1 and Sep 3.
macro.manufacturingRead: New Orders 56.7, Production 58.5, Employment 52.8 and Backlog 55.0 remain supportive while prices and electrical-component scarcity favour suppliers with pricing power.
macro.servicesRead: Business Activity and New Orders remain strong, but Employment 47.4 and Prices 70.3 argue against labour-heavy contractors with weak margin protection.
macro.oil: WTI settled Aug 25 near $82.36 despite Iran/Hormuz headlines. Refined-product scarcity remains the better tactical signal than generic crude beta.
macro.riskRead: Physical AI demand remains strong, but long-duration financing quality, lease/SPV exposure and future depreciation/dilution require a higher evidence threshold.

categoryReview.Power / Grid: UP RELATIVE RANK. GEV/PWR/ETN remain core; TNB and Southern Cable gain relative appeal because grid/electrical scarcity survives changes in AI vendor or financing mix.
categoryReview.AI / Data centres: SPLIT. BDC/GNRC/AMKR/ASMPT improve relative to pure narrative exposure because they have real orders, backlog, customer funding or scarce qualified capacity. VRT/NationGate-type high-beta exposure requires a wider margin of safety.
categoryReview.Nuclear: UP QUALITY / DOWN SPECULATION. BWXT/CEG/1816.HK improve relative to OKLO/SMR because operating assets and cash earnings matter more when financing risk rises.
categoryReview.Uranium / Fuel: UNCHANGED TO SLIGHTLY POSITIVE. CCJ/LEU remain the cleaner scarcity expressions.
categoryReview.Oil & Gas: REFINED-PRODUCT / GAS-INFRA BIAS. XOM remains a quality anchor; WMB/KMI/LNG gain relative appeal; STNG/VLO/MPC remain tactical; pure upstream beta does not get a broad upgrade.
categoryReview.Metals: COPPER REMAINS PREFERRED. Structural grid demand is strong, but China's just-enough stance caps enthusiasm for a generic industrial-metals stimulus trade.
categoryReview.Robotics / Automation: COMMERCIAL ROI FIRST. SYM/CGNX/2590.HK improve relative to humanoid duration; 9880.HK remains speculative.
categoryReview.Malaysia: TNB/SCGBHD/YTLPOWR remain the main physical-stack group. YTLPOWR's asset thesis improves while funding/cash-conversion scrutiny also increases.
categoryReview.Hong Kong / China: ASMPT remains the strongest differentiated recent candidate. 1816.HK/0836.HK/1072.HK retain strategic-power roles without requiring a consumer-stimulus bazooka.

researchGaps: Next official ISM Manufacturing update is Sep 1; do not infer August internals before publication.
Need another reporting cycle to test cash conversion and customer-funding durability for BDC/GNRC/AMKR/ASMPT.
El Nino hydro-to-thermal and canal/freight effects remain scenarios until physical flow/reservoir evidence confirms them.
China policy remains selective; watch for a genuine demand-side change before upgrading broad China cyclicals.
